title: SSE multi-byte UTF-8 split-chunk handling
description: The raw_buf/buf two-stage approach for SSE decoding is correct and necessary. It handles the case where a multi-byte UTF-8 codepoint is split across two HTTP chunks, which is a real edge case that a naive str-based approach would panic on or corrupt. A future contributor might suggest simplifying to directly treating bytes as UTF-8 strings. They must not — that would either panic (strict conversion) or silently corrupt data (lossy conversion). The current approach is the right answer.
